normalized.title: Refurbishment and improvement of the S5E location
normalized.description:
The S5E is a location dedicated to the maintenance of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as textile clothing, Personal Breathing Apparatus, scape operator, hoses or air bottles. All of this equipment is available to satellite customers and all users of the launch base. Today, the building no longer meets the ergonomic requirements and is not adapted to the cleanliness requirements that must be met by the revalidation flows of equipment used in clean rooms.
The objective of the proposed work is to refurbish the entire S5E location to improve the ergonomics and working conditions of operators, optimize revalidation times and create a flow of traffic where 'clean and revalidated' PPE do not use the same circuit as 'used-dirty' PPE.
